mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deepening recessionary pressures that trigger risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of weak GDP growth (GDPC1 below 22000 billion dollars) and high unemployment (UNRATE above 4.0%) signals severe economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 < 22000 and UNRATE > 4.0, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS above 4.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy stance reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) indicates manufacturing sector contraction that signals economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 310) indicates stable price environment that enables prolonged accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 310, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint weakness in housing (HOUST below 1400) and consumer spending (RSAFS below 700000) signals broad-based economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 700000, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS above 158000) indicates robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 158000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
